Bidding Rings and the Winner’s Curse: The Case of Offshore Federal Oil and Gas Lease Auctions
abstract: This paper extends the theory of legal cartels to affiliated private value and common value environments, and applies the theory to explain joint bidding patterns in U.S. federal government offshore oil and gas lease auctions. We show that efficient collusion is always possible in private value environments, but may not be in common value environments. In the latter case, fear of the winner's curse can cause bidders not to bid, which leads to inefficient trade. Buyers with high signals may be better off if no one colludes. The bid data is consistent with oil and gas leases being common value assets, and with the prediction that the winner's curse can prevent rings from forming on marginal tracts.
abstract_zh: 本文将合法卡特尔理论拓展至具有关联私人价值和共同价值的环境中，并应用该理论解释美国联邦政府海上石油和天然气租约拍卖中的联合投标模式。我们证明，在私人价值环境中，有效的串通总是可能的，但在共同价值环境中则未必。在后一种情形下，对赢家诅咒的担忧可能使竞标者不愿出价，从而导致低效的交易。若无人串通，持有高信号的买方可能境况更好。投标数据与石油和天然气租约属于共同价值资产的假设相一致，也与赢家诅咒可能阻止投标联盟在边际地块上形成这一预测相一致。

title: Auctions for Oil and Gas Leases with an Informed Bidder and a Random Reservation Price
abstract: The authors analyze a first-price, sealed bid auction of an object with unknown common value, but one buyer has better information. The reservation price is correlated with the informed buyer's assessment of the value and of the probability of rejection. If all random variables are affiliated, the rate of increase in the distribution of the uninformed bid is never greater than that of the informed bid, the distributions are identical above the support of the reservation price, and the informed buyer is more likely to submit low bids. Bids for offshore oil and gas leases on drainage tracts satisfy these restrictions. Copyright 1994 by The Econometric Society.
abstract_zh: 作者分析了一种首价密封投标拍卖，其标的具有未知的共同价值，但其中一名买方拥有更好的信息。保留价与知情买方对价值的评估以及对拒绝概率的评估相关。若所有随机变量相互关联（affiliated），则非知情方投标分布的上升速度永远不会超过知情方投标分布，二者在保留价支撑集之上的分布相同，且知情买方更可能提交较低的报价。针对排水区（drainage tracts）海上油气租约的投标满足这些限制条件。版权所有 1994 年，计量经济学会（The Econometric Society）。

title: Reputations in the Adoption of New Technology
Asymmetric Information, Information Externalities, and Efficiency: The Case of Oil Exploration
abstract: In this article we examine the effect of private information and information externalties on the ex post efficiency of investment in oil exploration. We show that too much drilling tends to occur if firms believe that the area is likely to contain a sizeable pool of oil, and too little drilling occurs if the opposite is true. Bargaining with well-defined property rights to the information externality can eliminate underinvestment, but overinvestment remains a problem because firms have an incentive not to disclose their private information.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了私人信息和信息外部性对石油勘探投资事后效率的影响。我们表明，若企业相信该区域可能蕴藏大量石油，则会出现钻探过度；若情况相反，则会出现钻探不足。若对信息外部性建立明确的产权，并通过谈判加以利用，可以消除投资不足，但投资过度仍然是一个问题，因为企业有动机不披露其私人信息。
